integrity: Statements are derived from path-basis multiplication and a support-gap proof, with finite computations used only as corroboration. No external mathematical validation or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced geometric square-zero locus is studied; classification concerns all top-dimensional components but does not exclude additional lower-dimensional components. Does not address nilpotent thickening, singularity scheme, or cycles shorter than four. Literature uniqueness is not certified.
title: Perrin top components and motivic square-zero strata in fourth-truncated cyclic quiver algebras
